name: deep-research
description: Seed broad searches, plan parts with completion bars for Caller approval, research in bounded rounds judged against those bars, and return a cited Markdown report with explicit gaps.

work.name: Read sources in parallel

met.instructions: Does the evidence meet every approved plan part's doneWhen bar? The feedback holds items (worker results with ids r<iteration>-<index>, each with its task and its claims or error) and gaps (open gaps from the previous round). Judge each part only against its own doneWhen. A part whose doneWhen says it is derived from other parts is met when those parts are met. A gap that does not block a doneWhen does not count. Worker excerpts and schema validity are evidence, not proof; secondary claims meet a bar only when the bar allows them.

criteria.true: Every approved part's doneWhen is met by the evidence, and no remaining gap blocks a doneWhen.
criteria.false: At least one approved part's doneWhen is not yet met by the evidence.

evaluator.name: Write gap tasks

synthesize.name: Cited research report
